chunks: Have you then become so sure that He will not cleave the earth and sink you in it by the shore, or send a gale against you, when you will not find any protector.

key_terms.حَاصِبًا: a storm of stones or wind with stones

ai.seo_question: What are the two forms of punishment mentioned in Surah Al-Isra regarding God's power over the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the fragility of human security, reminding believers that divine retribution can strike either through subterranean cataclysms or aerial storms, leaving no intercessor or protector. It underscores the concept of *Tawhid* in power, where reliance on worldly defenses is futile without God's pleasure, a theme often linked to the Day of Judgment when no advocate will suffice.
